messages:
elaine (Content): Folks — final shortlist for the April micro-webinar topics. Pick one: A) "Practical inference: serving tradeoffs for production" B) "When to use dedicated vs hosted for real-time" C) "How caching & batching saved X% on cost"
maria (Marketing Lead): Leaning B + C combo. narrative: migration story -> decision rubric -> measured outcomes. keeps it concrete for eng audiences.
sam (Growth): Agree. CTA strategy: H1: trial signup / H2: request a pilot. We'll route H1 to self-serve, H2 to AMs.
jordan (Analytics): For post-event capture, add hidden field on registration: "deployment_interest" with values hosted|dedicated|private. We'll tag leads and export CSV to SFDC.
tara (Producer): Run-of-show proposal (40m total):
- 00:00 intro (maria) 5m
- 05:00 product framing (elaine) 5m
- 10:00 demo 1 (Priya) 10m
- 20:00 demo 2 (Omar) 10m
- 30:00 customer vignette (Jess) 5m
- 35:00 panel Q&A 5m
- 40:00 CTA + wrap 2-3m
katie (Speaker Ops): Rehearsal slots: Mon/Wed 9-12 PT. Each speaker: 25m (5m mic/check + 20m dry-run). Priya asked for a separate 10m stage check for network.
maria (Marketing Lead): Benchmarks we show must have method notes. Jordan, prepare a one-pager with: test harness, sample prompt, concurrency, sequence length distribution, and cost calc.
jordan (Analytics): Will do. ETA: tomorrow noon. will include p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens.
sam (Growth): Subject lines to A/B (different from previous threads): Variant A: "Serving LLMs: pick the right deployment for your SLA" Variant B: "Host or dedicate? Real-world tradeoffs for inference"
elaine (Content): Draft abstracts (short):
- Abstract A (rubric): "We show a practical decision flow for choosing hosted, dedicated, or private deployments, with latency & cost examples."
- Abstract B (migration case): "A SaaS team moved hot-path inference from hosted to dedicated — we walk through signals, rollout, and lessons learned."
- Abstract C (ops): "How caching + batching reduced per-token costs and improved p95 latency in production."

tara (Producer): Technical ops checklist for live: presenter's laptop locked to presenter view, local network check, fallback clip uploaded, producer traffic script in repo. Also plan: record + stream backup to S3.

katie (Speaker Ops): Naming convention for clips: webinar-YYYYMMDD-speaker-demo-v1.mp4. Please upload 48h prior. I'll send invites with required assets list.
maria (Marketing Lead): Demo inputs: keep them deterministic. sample input set in repo: ["short prompt", "mid prompt - 512 tokens", "long prompt - 1024 tokens"]. Also include a synthetic load tool for the benchmark demo.
jordan (Analytics): Example traffic command (for producer):
```
python load_tool.py --model redwood-4 --concurrency 8 --prompts sample_prompts.json --duration 30
```
(we'll publish this in the benchmark appendix)
tara (Producer): Fallback plan: if live demo latency spikes >2x p95 -> cut to pre-recorded demo (keep cut time <20s). We'll have an overlay "demo paused - playing recorded clip".
infra-bot: uploaded assets: https://s3.redwood-inference.example/marketing/webinar/5487654321/ (slides, clips, runbook). presigned links expire in 72h.
sam (Growth): Promo schedule: 2 weeks out announce, 3 reminders (7d, 2d, 2h), Linkedin + dev newsletter + targeted ads for eng leads. I'll drop the calendar template.
maria (Marketing Lead): Last item: follow-up email copy must include cheat sheet, links to benchmark appendix, and two CTAs (trial, request pilot). Elaine/sam pair on the copy. Locking run-of-show tomorrow AM unless objections. :rocket:
